requirements.title: Period-over-period comparative analytics
criteria: Reconcile absolute and percentage changes against live period totals
Handle zero prior value, date boundaries and branch scope
requirements.detail: Dashboard provides no period-over-period comparison configuration or results

requirements.title: Complex assemblies and serialized units
criteria: Assembly capability is cross-covered by F02-k
Unique serial assignment, receipt/sale traceability and duplicate prevention
requirements.detail: Valid assembly behavior is cross-covered by F02-k, but serialized-unit assignment is unavailable.

requirements.title: Product Bundles & Kits (BOM / Composite Items)
requirements.detail: Valid 2A+3B recipe, availability 2, component value 47 and sale of two kits deducting 4A/6B pass; zero input silently becomes one. A cross-branch boundary sale succeeds with no components in the recorded sale branch and drives component stock negative.

requirements.title: Custom Category Fields
requirements.detail: Categories have no dynamic field definitions or schema assignment

requirements.title: Comparative Branch Performance Analytics
requirements.detail: Branch inventory units/value reconciled against independently paginated products. Period-scoped sales are presented; sales recognition/date-boundary and cross-branch financial eligibility are not fully certified.

requirements.title: Multi-Item Batch Adjustment Vouchers
requirements.detail: Positive two-item API voucher and negative-stock atomicity control pass; the native form accepts only one item.

requirements.title: Printable Dispatch Manifests & Delivery Slips
requirements.detail: Transfers have no printable dispatch manifest or delivery slip

requirements.title: Transit Damage & Discrepancy Dispute Logging
requirements.detail: In-transit receipt has no damage, shortage or discrepancy dispute entry

requirements.title: Scheduled Cycle Count Audits by Category
requirements.detail: Stock counts cannot be scheduled or scoped to a category

requirements.title: Live Barcode Scanner Count Auditing
requirements.detail: Count sheet has no barcode-driven counting workflow

requirements.title: Batch / Lot Number Assignment
requirements.detail: Standalone owned lots persist through the diagnostic API; manufacturer-lot capture during receipt is unavailable, and the batch selector cannot reach later-page products.

requirements.title: Expiry Date Tracking
requirements.detail: Per-lot dates and reload/display pass. Entering zero quantity silently creates a one-unit lot; native product selection also has the first-page limitation.

requirements.title: Expiry Warning System
requirements.detail: Expired, tomorrow-expiry and fresh lots display the expected visual states; matching filters show each owned lot. This requirement asks for visual indicators, not outbound delivery.

requirements.title: FIFO / FEFO Inventory Rules
requirements.detail: An owned expiry-enabled product is sold four times with receipt order opposed to expiry order. The native priority is consistent through first-lot exhaustion; remaining lot totals reconcile with independent physical stock. No claim of two separately selectable modes.

requirements.title: Expired Stock Disposal Workflow
requirements.detail: Expired batches expose delete metadata but no supervised stock disposal workflow

requirements.title: Offline Resilience (IndexedDB)
requirements.detail: Offline checkout fails without storing a durable queued sale

requirements.title: Customer Loyalty Points Redemptions at POS
requirements.detail: POS has no customer loyalty balance or redemption workflow

requirements.title: Live Order Queue Display
requirements.detail: Diagnostic processing-enabled order progresses through queue states. Native Processing product creation saves requires_processing=false and its normal POS sale does not create a ticket.

requirements.title: Ticket Assignment
requirements.detail: Processing ticket editor cannot assign a technician, service bay or table

requirements.title: Kitchen / Work Order Thermal Printing
requirements.detail: Order queue has no thermal work-order ticket generation action

requirements.title: Automated Recurring Invoicing
requirements.detail: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured

requirements.title: Multi-Currency Billing
requirements.detail: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate

requirements.title: Automated Overdue Payment Email Reminders
requirements.detail: Invoice Due Reminders and email channel controls exist in Notifications > Settings. Actual overdue email dispatch/delivery cannot be certified without a controlled QA inbox.

requirements.title: Standalone Credit Notes without Invoice Link
requirements.detail: Standalone credit creation succeeds, but Save as Draft submits Open and adds stock without a receiving choice; all owned stock changes compensated.

requirements.title: Issue Debit Note
requirements.detail: A valid supplemental debit draft with total 100 persists. Issued accounting and dedicated freight/service-line coverage are not fully verified.

requirements.title: Invoice Reference Linking
requirements.detail: A new owned debit note retains its selected synthetic paid invoice ID after reload and displays that reference on the printable document.

requirements.title: PDF Generation & Dispatch
requirements.detail: Authenticated browser print view and A4 PDF preserve the debit number, customer, selected product name/SKU and amount; PDF visually reviewed. Email dispatch lacks a controlled inbox; physical printing skipped.

requirements.title: Automated Low-Stock Reordering
requirements.detail: Low-stock items have no automatic purchase-order reordering workflow

requirements.title: Direct Supplier Email Transmission
requirements.detail: Purchase-order detail has no direct supplier email transmission action

requirements.title: Batch & Expiry Capture at Ingestion
requirements.detail: Goods receiving cannot capture manufacturer lots or lot expiry dates

requirements.title: 3-Way Reconciliation (PO vs GRN vs Bill)
requirements.detail: Bill entry provides PO linking but no three-way receipt reconciliation

requirements.title: Supplier Product Catalogs & Preferred Vendor SKUs
requirements.detail: Owned supplier mapping stores its vendor-specific SKU, preferred flag and lead time; attach/read/detach pass. The native catalogue hides the vendor SKU and searching that SKU returns no product.

requirements.title: Supplier Account Statement Export
requirements.detail: Supplier export downloads profile fields rather than an account statement

requirements.title: Customer Groups & Tiers (Retail, Wholesale, VIP)
requirements.detail: Customer groups and automatic pricing tiers cannot be configured

requirements.title: Strict Credit Limit Blocking
requirements.detail: Customer account UI has no credit enablement or debt ceiling configuration

requirements.title: Gross Profit & Net Margin Deep-Dive
requirements.detail: Revenue and revenue-minus-recorded-cost/displayed gross margin arithmetic pass. Net-margin deep dive is missing; catalogue-versus-recorded COGS provenance remains unverified.

requirements.title: Stock Movement & Velocity Ledger
requirements.detail: A controlled +1 adjustment appears as a new stock movement with the correct resulting balance; stock restored. Dedicated velocity metric definitions and historical reconciliation are not fully certified.

requirements.title: Customer & Supplier Aging Debtors/Creditors Analysis
requirements.detail: AR buckets are reconstructed from live invoice dates/balances and totals reconcile. Supplier/creditor aging is absent from the report catalogue/Bills controls.

requirements.title: Visual Custom Report Builder
requirements.detail: Report builder only saves predefined report choices rather than custom dimensions and metrics

requirements.title: Saved Report Templates
requirements.detail: Filtered saved template create/reload/run/delete passes. Valid unfiltered templates return filters as [] and disappear from the client list.

requirements.title: Automated Scheduled Reports via Cron Email
requirements.detail: Cadence/recipient schedule form inspected. No active schedule created without a controlled inbox; cron firing, delivered CSV and retry behavior are unverified.

requirements.title: Drag-and-Drop Visual Canvas Designer
requirements.detail: Document Builder has presets and form controls but no drag-and-drop design canvas

requirements.title: Custom Font Upload & Management
requirements.detail: Invalid extension is rejected. Valid native TTF upload loses bytes and returns 422; diagnostic multipart upload/list/exact file-hash/delete pass without changing original fonts.

requirements.title: Granular Custom Permission Matrix Builder
requirements.detail: Users & Roles has no custom role or granular permission matrix editor

requirements.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP)
requirements.detail: Enable control is available after the real account load. Enrollment/login/time-window/replay tests require an isolated activated account; shared owner factors were preserved.

requirements.title: Backup Recovery Codes
requirements.detail: Recovery code generation, one-time use and recovery login depend on isolated TOTP enrollment; no suitable activated account is available.

requirements.title: Remote Active Session Revocation
requirements.detail: Revoked automation session retains authenticated account access

requirements.title: Before-and-After Value Diffs
requirements.detail: Live campaign product archive transitions contain active-to-archived old/new values; the UI has diff columns and exported values preserve them.

requirements.title: Compliance Export (CSV/JSON)
requirements.detail: Native filtered CSV export includes Old/New Value columns and its row count matches the complete filtered paginated result. JSON export is not exposed; the slash-format requirement needs confirmation before full acceptance.

requirements.title: API Key Management
requirements.detail: Owned key naming/create/list/rotate/revoke/delete pass. Secrets are absent from list data; explicit empty-session controls accept the active key and refuse invalid/old/revoked keys. Secrets remain private.

requirements.title: Scoped Permissions per Key
requirements.detail: Global read-only denial (403) and write-enabled update (200 plus independent persistence) pass on an owned product. Anonymous/invalid credentials return 401. Per-resource restricted scopes are not exposed/tested.

requirements.title: Full RESTful API Documentation
requirements.detail: API documentation lacks a resource reference and falsely says API keys cannot authenticate

requirements.title: Real-Time Webhooks
requirements.detail: Webhook subscriptions omit the three events required by the specification

requirements.title: Webhook Delivery Logs & Manual Retries
requirements.detail: No controlled webhook receiver exists and no endpoint is registered. Actual signed deliveries, persisted delivery logs and manual retry outcomes are not verified. A page notice is not backend proof.

requirements.title: Direct ESC/POS Network & Serial Drivers
requirements.detail: Physical ESC/POS network/serial connection and paper output skipped at user request. Software connect controls and browser API availability inspected; no hardware mock counted as acceptance.

requirements.title: Cash Drawer RJ11 Auto-Kick Pulse
requirements.detail: Physical RJ11 cash drawer kick/pulse skipped at user request because no drawer/printer is connected.

requirements.title: Adhesive Barcode Label Roll Printers
requirements.detail: Software label generation is unavailable. Physical label-printer execution is separately skipped at user request.

requirements.title: Automated Database Backup & JSON Dump Export
requirements.detail: Advanced JSON export only shows a toast, with no job/download. No automated backup configuration/history workflow is exposed; unseen backend jobs/restoration are not certified.

requirements.title: Outgoing Email & SMS Gateway Delivery
requirements.detail: Actual notification settings/channel preferences inspected without saving changes. No controlled email inbox, SMS number/gateway or delivery receiver is available for end-to-end verification.

requirements.title: Interactive Searchable Knowledge Base & Video Guides
requirements.detail: Positive/negative FAQ search and answer expansion pass; no video guides are available.

requirements.title: System Changelog & Release Notes Feed
requirements.detail: Changelog route, visible release entries and descending dates pass. The static 2025 history is not certified as current deployment/release provenance; no authoritative backend build revision is available.
